reviews.author: Darius Kahan
reviews.text: Walter is great! I live in Manhattan and brought my Jaguar to NJ to save money on a repair but wanted it to be done well. Drove around to get 4-5 quotes before choosing this place. Walter did an amazing job for a great price.

reviews.author: Jung-woo Sohn
reviews.text: This is an excellent auto body shop. My car has been restored to the original condition perfectly. Walter did a wonderful job and paid attentions to the details. I really appreciate his work and highly recommend Elizabeth Auto Body Shop to anybody needing auto body repair work. Nov. 6th: Had another minor accident and came back here to fix my car. Walter did a great job again and restored my car in a perfect condition.

reviews.author: David Demianicz
reviews.text: Walter was amazing. Fixed the front of my car with a new condenser for half the price the dealership wanted. Project was completed on time and cleaned up very nicely. This isn't my first time here and won't be my last because Walter's pricing is very competitive and doesn't make you feel ripped off. Great place to fix up any damage around ur car

reviews.author: Danny Saborio
reviews.text: Went to this shop due to needing a new painted bumper for my Toyota Corolla S and they took care of me pretty well. Even added a light touch up to my fog lights so the whole set up would look really nice. I highly recommend. Convenient, speedy and quality work! I arrived and he had it right there waiting for me.

reviews.author: Kofi Fii
reviews.text: Walter takes care of me every time, been to him 3 times already! Does a good job and very reasonable pricing. Recommend!!

reviews.author: Paulette Pearson
reviews.text: Our daughter car chevy cruz needed body work done and they did an absolutely Amazing job and got it back to us very quick. I will recommend ALL my family & friends to them.

reviews.author: sushil singh
reviews.text: I took my car to this shop based on google rating and Walter gave me a reasonable quote. He did really good job and fixed the car on time in one day. Overall, happy with the service and would recommend anyone looking to to get auto body work.

reviews.author: russ H
reviews.text: I was greeted by the friendly staff, received an extremely competitive quote for my repair. I was slightly apprehensive since their quote and completion estimate as better than the comparison. I am very cost conscious so I went with these guys, they finished as promised with amazing quality. I do not do a bunch of reviews but my expectations we exceeded.

reviews.author: JP Smedile
reviews.text: Walter was professional from day 1 til the day I picked up my truck. Not over priced, especially for the quality of work performed!

reviews.author: Pedro Castillo
reviews.text: If you want paint or any auto body work just come here..Very good service and wonderful prices...Far away the best in Elizabeth area
